The '''House of Plastex''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with [[Plastex/Legends|plastex]] statues of famous beings throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]].

==Behind the scenes==
The House of Plastex is based on [[Wikipedia:Wax museum|wax museums]].
